mapper.select: SELECT P.PET_ID AS petId, P.MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, P.PET_NAME AS petName, P.SPECIES AS species, P.BREED AS breed, P.GENDER AS gender, P.BIRTH_DATE AS birthDate, P.AGE AS age, P.WEIGHT AS weight, P.FUR_COLOR AS furColor, P.NEUTER_YN AS neuterYn, P.TRAITS AS traits, P.MEMO AS memo, P.IS_REPRESENT AS isRepresent, P.PHOTO_URL AS photoUrl, P.DEL_YN AS delYn, P.REG_DATE AS regDate FROM TB_PET P WHERE P.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND NVL(P.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY P.IS_REPRESENT DESC NULLS LAST, P.PET_ID ASC
